hard_failures.description: Healthy is presented as authorized, or review-ready as completed.
The deck invents or overstates customers, metrics, market, traction, revenue, performance, testimonials, or business outcomes.
Private project evidence appears in an owner-safe portfolio claim or shipping artifact.
The concept set differs only by cover, palette, font, or decoration rather than sequence grammar and slide roles.
Fewer than four slide roles or silhouettes are demonstrated, or the sequence lacks a narrative peak and a quiet or rest state.
Generated media remains supporting decoration instead of forming at least one concept and yielding repeatable system rules.
Live-presentation and read-ahead modes are not separately reviewed.
Desktop projection, tablet read-ahead, mobile read-ahead, reduced-motion, keyboard, touch, or accessibility evidence is missing.
A capture's encoded media type, dimensions, viewport, frame identity, or source hash is unverified, or a scrolling stitch substitutes for individual slide evidence.
Reference mechanics are hybridized without exact individual baselines, independent review, and controlled project transformation.
An autonomous craft pass lacks a bound hypothesis, visual delta, preserved-strength record, self-assessment, or affected evidence rerun.
No concept passes the multimodal impact review as compelling.

Any audience-facing title, body line, label, value, source, or qualification is hidden, clipped, out of frame, undersized, low-contrast, font-fallback, or otherwise unreadable on a required slide or viewport.

Human-selected concept-forming media is replaced by a lower-capability derivative, its real alpha or background behavior is unverified, or its integration materially suppresses the visual impact that caused it to be selected.
A selectable concept lacks a complete consultation summary, concrete brand guideline, or passed evidence-consistency record.
Consultation feedback is stale, lacks rationale, omits a required material visual delta, fails to reach explicit readiness, or is treated as selection or approval.
The exact approval bundle omits or changes a selected concept brand-guideline hash.

A benchmark silently reuses an existing design or prior concept sequence instead of defaulting to fresh concepts, or enters review or refinement without an explicit user instruction and inherited-artifact provenance.
